resumeText:
Rahul Patidar | Indore | rahul.patidar@example.com | +91 98260 00000

EDUCATION
BBA (Finance), Prestige Institute of Management and Research, Indore, 2026 | CGPA 7.4/10
Class XII (Commerce), MP Board, 2023 | 81%

INTERNSHIPS
Collections Intern, Narmada Fincorp Pvt Ltd (two-wheeler loans NBFC), Indore | May 2025 - July 2025 (10 weeks)
- Called 50 overdue two-wheeler loan borrowers daily and recorded promises to pay in the CRM.
- Explained EMI dates, bounce charges and foreclosure terms to borrowers who had missed one EMI.
- Updated the daily collection MIS in Excel for the branch collections manager.
- Joined a senior field officer on 15 home visits to borrowers in the 30+ days bucket.

Sales Intern, Malwa Microfinance, Dewas | June 2024 - July 2024 (6 weeks)
- Surveyed 80 women self-help group members about loan needs and repayment habits.

PROJECTS
- BBA research project: Compared bounce rates of salaried and self-employed two-wheeler borrowers using a sample of 200 accounts.
- Group project for the Banking course: Prepared a presentation on how NBFCs recover dues on personal loans.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- IIBF Debt Recovery Agent certificate, 2025
- Coursework: Banking and Insurance, Business Law, Financial Management

SKILLS
Tele-calling, MS Excel, Bucket-wise collections (0-30, 30+, 60+), RBI Fair Practices Code, CRM software, Hindi, English

ACTIVITIES
- Spoke to borrowers in Hindi and Malwi during calls and visits to keep conversations calm.
- Volunteer, college NSS unit, 2023-25.
